purpose: Explain historical 40.4%, current 85%, and upstream 96% using archived run artifacts; no model run performed.

historical_teacher_1000.grounding_error_semantics: The snapshot oral_text_generator.py raises the same message for a combined condition: unsupported_edits OR surface_issues OR lock_training_target(...) is None (lines 358-361). numeric_policy.py lock_training_target returns None for numeric lock failure OR English entity preservation failure (lines 146-151). Therefore 686 is a warning event count for a mixed guard, not 686 numerical false rejections; a candidate may generate multiple warning events/retries.
historical_teacher_1000.status_interpretation: Oral rejection 347 is unique final candidate status count; 686 grounding warnings include retries and are not additive to status counts.
historical_teacher_1000.denominator_note: 40.4% is retained per 1000 candidate attempts; among 653 candidates with valid Oral output, retention is 404/653 = 61.9%.

repair_matched_300.comparison: Same 300 candidate IDs/seed pools/model/control RNG; stochastic teacher responses can differ. Effective-Oral denominators are arm-specific: baseline 202 candidates (300−98 oral rejects), current repair 280 (300−20); retention is 125/202=61.9% versus 197/280=70.4%. This is distinct from the fixed-Oral 85% replay.

current_auto_acceptance_300.denominator: 300 fixed Oral candidates replayed through acceptance stages
current_auto_acceptance_300.comparison_caveat: Replay of fixed Oral candidates, not fresh end-to-end generation throughput; semantic/ASR calls stochastic.
current_auto_acceptance_300.denominator_note: 85.0% is 255 unique retained per all 300 replay candidates. Excluding 20 oral rejects, effective-Oral retention is 255/280 = 91.1%.

upstream_500.explanation: 96% denominator is 500 valid upstream oral examples, with 480 retained after QC; this is a valid-Oral retention rate, not a full end-to-end rate. The 557 checkpoint attempts are incomplete as a total-request denominator.
upstream_500.generation_attempts_note: The 557 count is attempts recorded at the submitted original-batch checkpoint. Some attempts were aborted or queued during the switch; it is not a complete total-request denominator.

historical_vs_fixed_problem.historical_issue: Broad oral grounding guard over-combined unsupported semantic edits, surface checks, numeric surface lock, and English entity preservation behind one error label. The 1000-run warning count cannot identify which subguard failed.
historical_vs_fixed_problem.subsequent_repair_evidence: Repair snapshot adds an explicit synthetic construction proof (generation_plan) and accepts only exact source/target construction matches through _construction_plan_matches; fallback still enforces numeric and English constraints. This addresses false rejection of correctly constructed rollback/multiple examples that the old generic comparison could not prove.
historical_vs_fixed_problem.remaining_loss_evidence: In the matched 300 current run, oral rejections fall 98 to 20 while clean rejections rise 8 to 33; audit remains 37 to 38. Losses moved to downstream stages and are not all resolved by historical guard repair.
